data.content_ref: inline:Covering principle: any admissible strengthening of the grounded extension must be a polynomial-time, monotone edge-construction enrichment applied before the skeptical fixed point, never a modification of the fixed-point operator or its derived labels. Weights, bounded defense precomputation, RESIDUE annotations, and re-examination passes all become projections of, or inputs to, this single enrichment layer. Because the enrichment is monotone and polynomial, the fixed point remains deterministic and polynomial; reinstatement remains a theorem about the enriched graph; and committed-root validity is preserved because enrichment is conservative over committed roots—it can add warrants but never deletes or relabels a committed root outside the same fixpoint.
